qwen3_report.finding: Uses off-policy response distillation followed by on-policy logit distillation; its approximately tenfold cost comparison is Qwen3-8B under its own setup, not a cost forecast for this project.

sequential_paper.finding: Supports OPD followed by RL as an established baseline; Qwen3-1.7B-Base and Qwen3-8B, DeepMath, different contexts and budgets.

compatibility_paper.finding: Teacher-student compatibility matters; stronger RL initialization can regress under subsequent OPD, so a stronger teacher or smaller KL is not sufficient.

lora_study.finding: Observed roughly tenfold LoRA-to-full-finetuning optimal LR ratio in its experiments; does not imply multiplying the current project's existing LoRA LR by ten.

tml_opd.finding: Sampled-token teacher minus old-student log probabilities; immediate token signal with discount factor zero.

qwen_official.finding: Official CoT chat rendering and publicly released 1.5B/7B math instruct models.
